Name: (CP) Dacar Ridgeside Village anime style portraits
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000]**The CP version for 1.6 of this mod currently  needs Portraiture to work, once HD portraits is updated I'll change it**[/color][/b]
[color=#00ff00][b]**--Instructions for 1.6 CP for Portaiture--*[/b]
[b]Just download the mod and put it in the mods folder.[/b]
[b]In order to see the portraits you'll need Portraiture and do one of this two things:[/b]
[b]-Once inside the game press "P" (by default it may be different depending on your settings) until you see HDP[/b]
[b]-In Portraiture config setting  change this to not have to cycle through your portraits:[/b]
[b]"active": "HDP"[/b][/color]

This mod has a version for  Portraiture, in case you don't want to use CP.

 For now it should have every portrait needed, but some maybe won't appear as I didn't test them due to not knowing when they appear (for example Ysabelle Ball), if anyone knows when they appear I'll try to include them.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6509pQY9/Next-Projects.png[/img]
